description: Evidence-gated retrospective audit for questions already closed by a human.
negative_controls: A plausible wording preference such as 那/哪 is not enough to reset an accepted question.
A generic image asset or image_refs flag is not proof of a missing/wrong image.
A source_unverified or human_pdf finding may be displayed, but its correction_applicable flag must be false.
A valid-looking Latin scientific name is not a reset reason without exact local source evidence; model memory is never enough.
An English semantic anchor such as hydrogen bond(s) overrides generic glyph conversion and must be explained before reset.
A full options patch contains only key and text; parser display metadata never enters a correction payload.
